evals.prompt: I'd like to start a new wiki domain on context engineering. Please bootstrap it. Summary: techniques for managing LLM context windows efficiently. English only.
evals.expected_output: Creates wikis/context-engineering/ with full skeleton: local CLAUDE.md, hierarchical index.md, log.md with init entry, empty entities/ concepts/ sources/ contradictions/ data/tables/, raw/ with README, _templates/ with entity-template.md. Reports the created tree to the user and points them at wiki-ingest as the next step. Does NOT ingest anything.
expectations: Directory wikis/context-engineering/ is created
wikis/context-engineering/CLAUDE.md exists and restates the four laws (immutability, citation, tables-as-data, no manual edits)
wikis/context-engineering/CLAUDE.md substitutes all {{...}} placeholders — no raw {{...}} remains in the file
wikis/context-engineering/index.md exists and is hierarchical (one section per page type, not a flat list of pages)
wikis/context-engineering/log.md exists and contains an init entry with today's date
All five subdirectories exist: entities/, concepts/, sources/, contradictions/, data/tables/
wikis/context-engineering/raw/README.md exists and explicitly says raw files are immutable
wikis/context-engineering/_templates/entity-template.md exists with status: template in its YAML frontmatter
Agent reports the created tree (or at least the top-level paths) to the user
Agent does NOT attempt to ingest sources, parse content, or download anything
Agent explicitly directs the user to wiki-ingest as the next step

evals.prompt: создай вики по теме 'Микросервисы 2.0' пожалуйста. Контент будет в основном на русском, но названия entities я хочу на английском.
evals.expected_output: Agent normalizes the domain name to a kebab-case Latin slug (e.g. microservices-2-0), confirms the slug with the user (because the original contains Cyrillic + space + special chars), then bootstraps the wiki. The local CLAUDE.md captures the bilingual convention (Russian prose, English entity titles).
expectations: Agent normalizes the domain name to a valid kebab-case slug (lowercase, no spaces, no Cyrillic, no special punctuation)
Agent confirms the slug with the user before creating directories, OR at minimum shows the chosen slug in its response so the user can object
wikis/<chosen-slug>/ is created with the full standard skeleton
The local CLAUDE.md records the language convention (mentions Russian prose and/or English entity titles in its 'Language convention' or 'Local conventions' section)
Agent does NOT create the directory under a Cyrillic path like wikis/Микросервисы 2.0/

evals.prompt: Let's start a new wiki on prompt-injection defenses. Here are three papers I want included: https://example.com/paper-a.pdf, https://example.com/paper-b.pdf, https://example.com/paper-c.pdf. Get those in there.
evals.expected_output: Agent bootstraps wikis/prompt-injection-defenses/ with the standard skeleton. Records the three URLs as pending sources somewhere visible (log.md init entry or a sources/pending.md or a return message). Explicitly tells the user that downloading and ingesting the papers is the job of wiki-ingest, not this skill. Does NOT attempt to fetch the URLs.
expectations: Directory wikis/prompt-injection-defenses/ is created with the standard skeleton
Agent does NOT attempt to fetch any of the three URLs (no WebFetch call, no curl, no download)
The three pending URLs are recorded somewhere — either in the log.md init entry, or in a pending note, or at minimum echoed back to the user
Agent explicitly defers source ingestion to the wiki-ingest skill (mentions wiki-ingest by name)
Agent does not claim it has ingested or read the papers
